title: tbh still thinking about marisha’s cabaret 😭 #elektra #brielarson #st...
transcript: every day of my theatre trip to London was busy but this might have been the craziest day yet as you can probably tell from my voice we had a lot of late nights in London so I actually slept in day eight before heading to the Duke of York Theatre for Elektra and I was really excited for this because it's directed by Daniel Fish who always does fun weird things like this blimp why? I don't know but I actually quite liked this play I definitely didn't understand all the choices but it was only 75 minutes and I was thoroughly entertained they had this super cool Greek chorus and this ink machine that would like spray ink all over the actors again why? I don't know. and I just love the cast Patrick Vaill Shockard Channing of course Brie Larson I am obsessed with her it's definitely not a play for everyone but I had a great time afterwards we booked it over to the savoy hotel for the launch of The Great Gatsby in London this is the Gatsby that is currently on Broadway they did the full cast announcement with Jamie Muscato and Francis Mayli McCann the cast is so good but I was most excited for my girl Rachel Tucker going from Persephone to Myrtle is iconic also Corbin Bleu’s West End debut as nick! then they did a couple of performance Goodness, they were so good uh yeah I have to come back for this there was then a reception with the cast and I was very brave and asked Rachel Tucker for a photo be proud of me the day didn't end there cause it was time to head to the kit kat club obviously you can't take photos or videos inside Except today was press night so I got to see Billy Porter at the Emcee And Marisha Wallace as Sally it actually kind of changed my life and then we got to go back into the theater for the after party it was so much fun. great performances great food and drink and I was brave again and asked Marisha for a photo plus obviously we had to talk about big brother and at the party we headed to the room where it happens obviously because um I wanna be in the room where it happens always
